usedFor: Docugami creates docsets and projects, and HubSpot receives the deal or contact that “Create Project” can start.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Project” in Docugami, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new Docugami project opens a deal in HubSpot, so the sales record exists once the document work does.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, and “Create Docsets” in Docugami is polling, so runs arrive on a schedule.
